name: The Reeve's Court
summary: The civil authority of Velkash and, by extension, the Crownlands. The High Reeve is elected every ten years by the salt-and-harvest council — grain magnates, silk-weavers, and shipwrights. The court is the Censer's great rival: it holds the law, the coin, and the people, while the Censer holds only fear.

history.event: Prehistory: the first Reeve of Velkash issues the Edict of Silence, banning the written Old Weaver. The office is born as an instrument of fear — a junior partner to the rising Censer.
The Crown Re-set: Velkash's White Step is rebuilt and the salt-and-harvest council established. The court renames itself capital of the Crownlands and begins to slip the Censer's leash.
The Salt Roads: the court strikes the first coins since the Sundering and opens southern trade. Coin becomes the court's weapon against Censer influence.

The Rememberers' Return: scholars emerge from the Hollow Mile with Old Weaver texts. The court protects them purely to spite the Censer — a power play that backfires when the texts begin to circulate.

Reeve Aldara of the White Step wants an expedition to the Ruin of Karvess; the Censer forbids it. The council is split, the Year of Ashfall has spooked the grain magnates, and the court's authority is tested.

structure.leadership: High Reeve Aldara of the White Step (elected, ~4 years remaining)
structure.council: the salt-and-harvest council: grain magnates, silk-weavers, shipwrights, well-sisters
structure.membership: the council of ~40, plus courts, tax-farmers, and the city watch

goals: Keep the Crownlands fed, taxed, and trading
Break the Censer's veto over expeditions and scholarship
Survive the Year of Ashfall without panic or famine
methods: Coin, tariffs, and the grain dole
Legal charters that quietly override Censer warrants
Patronage of scholars useful enough to protect

relations.note: Neither can destroy the other without destroying the peace both profit from.
The Mile bribes half the watch; the other half takes its cut from the bribes.
The court charters Storm-Bound convoys on the Veiled Sea routes.

adventure_hooks: The Reeve secretly commissions players for the Karvess expedition the Censer forbade.
A council seat falls vacant; the Censer backs a candidate who will sign purge writs without review.
Ashfall-poisoned grain is blamed on hollowborn caravans; the court must find truth before a pogrom starts.
